Package com.bilt.pos.session.settlement

Class PartialCardApproval

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.settlement.PartialCardApproval
public final class PartialCardApproval extends Object
Context supplied to SettlementFlow.onPartialCardApproval when a card payment committed with an authorized amount below the amount it requested. By then the payment's movement has been published and onCardCharged has fired. The handler returns a PartialApprovalDecision for the shortfall.

With implicit loyalty and multi-tender on the terminal, the partial payment can be the terminal's Bilt rewards leg: the member's rewards paid getApproved() and no card was in it. Then getBiltRewardsPayment() is that payment and isBiltRewards() is true; the register should report it to the shopper as rewards, not as a declined card.
